speechText.name: plain text
emphasis is read as its words and struck text is not
inline code is read as words
a link is read as its label
a bare web address is dropped
an address with www is dropped
an image is read as its description
a code block is not read
an indented code block is not read
a heading and a paragraph are two lines
a bullet list is one line per item
an ordered list is read with no numbers
a nested list is flattened
a quote is read as its words
a table is not read
a rule is not read
emoji are dropped
a line of only emoji is dropped
a line of only symbols is dropped
a task list loses its markers
a line break inside a paragraph is a blank
blanks are collapsed
nothing to say
only code
numbers and accents are kept
an unfinished bold span is read as its words
